author: Retro Game Corps
description:
Unexpectedly, the Anbernic RG Rotate has become one of my favorite compact handhelds of the year. Let's take a further look at what makes this unique handheld so special, and whether it'll be a good fit for you.

Anbernic direct: http://tinyurl.com/RG-Rotate
AliExpress: https://s.click.aliexpress.com/e/_c36jStOF

RG Rotate impressions video: https://youtu.be/_OaCJlkyNHQ
Android handheld starter guide: https://youtu.be/I4mqgcDYZFo

Screen protector: https://amzn.to/4dtVgO4
RAofflineproxy app: https://raofflineproxy.com/
Pico-8 on Android: https://github.com/Macs75/pico8-android
Favorite audio dongle: https://s.click.aliexpress.com/e/_c3cDke6f
UGREEN BT usb adapter: https://amzn.to/4eMiKQJ

This was a review unit sent to me by the manufacturer.  All opinions are my own, they did not see this review ahead of time, and no money was exchanged in any way.
